maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new HVAC equipment (cooling towers, boilers, fans, heaters) sold for new builds; aftermarket parts and service are a minority.

publicly_funded.reason: HVAC buyers are private commercial, industrial and residential customers; the Detection & Measurement segment (utilities, transit, defense) is smaller.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own engineered products, with regular bolt-on deals (Thermolec, Crawford United air handling, FIS) as a secondary route.

mission_critical.reason: Engineered HVAC products like cooling towers, boilers and fans are specified by engineers, but customers can switch brands on new projects.

notes: Mission-critical is a close call: specified engineered products and critical environments, but switching is mostly project by project.
